content: Verified by loop (attempt 1). and twice and the second attempt needed approval. The two new test files pass when run alone (18 tests). WHAT CHANGED: New `src/lib/money-client.test.ts` covers `newRequestId`, `fetchMoneyConfig` and `postMoney`, with Supabase and `fetch` mocked. I also added edge cases to `src/lib/phone.test.ts`. No source changes. HOW TO VERIFY: `npx vitest run src/lib/phone.test.ts src/lib/money-client.test.ts` passes. `npm run typecheck` and eslint on both files are clean. Run the full `npm test` yourself. RISKS: Low, tests only. The full suite is unconfirmed here.
